title_zh: 曝苹果新 CEO Ternus 希望更快发产品、精简组织
content_zh:
据彭博社报道，苹果新任 CEO John Ternus 正筹划调整公司组织与产品发布节奏，希望让苹果更精简、决策更快，以应对人工智能时代的竞争。

Ternus 认为，苹果需要更快推出产品、增加试验性；他也在评估减少对春季和秋季传统发布周期的依赖，改为全年更频繁地发布产品。

苹果明年计划推出多款设备，包括带摄像头的 AirPods、首款智能眼镜，以及为 iPhone 诞生 20 周年准备的重新设计机型。报道称，Ternus 正重新考虑新品发布安排，但改变苹果长期形成的开发流程可能需要数年。

组织调整也已开始。苹果硬件工程部门近两周裁撤了多名工程项目经理，其中包括约 6 名高级别主管；未能在公司内部找到其他岗位的员工，之后可能被解雇。

苹果近期还在 Siri、Vision Pro 和 AI 相关软件工程等团队进行裁员，并缩减或取消部分早期项目。

与此同时，Ternus 与服务业务负责人 Eddy Cue、财务负责人 Kevan Parekh 正讨论新的服务，以及从现有产品和服务中增加收入的方式。苹果服务业务增长放缓、内存成本上升，也给公司带来压力。报道指出，苹果还在控制成本，但尚未公布更广泛调整的具体时间表。
title_en: Apple's New CEO John Ternus Plans Major Shake-Up for Faster Product Launches and Leaner Org
content_en:
Apple's newly appointed CEO, John Ternus, is planning a significant overhaul of the company's organizational structure and product release cycle. According to Bloomberg, Ternus aims to make Apple leaner and faster at decision-making to better compete in the artificial intelligence era.

As part of this strategy, Ternus wants to accelerate product launches and foster a culture of experimentation. He is considering moving away from Apple's traditional spring and autumn launch events in favor of more frequent releases throughout the year. Next year's pipeline includes camera-equipped AirPods, Apple's first smart glasses, and a special redesigned iPhone to mark its 20th anniversary. However, restructuring Apple's deeply ingrained development processes could take several years.

Organizational restructuring is already underway. Apple's hardware engineering division recently laid off several engineering project managers, including about six senior directors. Layoffs have also hit teams working on Siri, Vision Pro, and AI-related software engineering, alongside the scaling back or cancellation of several early-stage projects.

Additionally, Ternus is collaborating with services head Eddy Cue and CFO Kevan Parekh to explore new services and boost revenue from existing offerings. This comes amid slowing growth in Apple's services sector and rising memory costs, prompting tighter cost controls across the company.

title_zh: 华为 Mate 90 真机进店，拼色机身与十倍变焦模块先亮相
content_zh:
华为 Mate 90 系列 9 月 29 日已在部分线下门店展示。新机采用双拼配色，现场可见绿色、黑色、灰色、白色、橙色等版本；Mate 90 RS 非凡大师也已展示。华为计划在 10 月 1 日 10:00 正式发布该系列，并于当日 12:08 开售。

门店同时展示了睿影 Z10 变焦模块。它内置 1 英寸传感器，提供 10 倍光学变焦，属于带独立成像硬件的外置相机模块，而非只在手机镜头前增加放大镜片的增距镜。它需与 Mate 90 Pro Max 典藏版、Mate 90 RS 非凡大师等指定型号配合使用，模块和手柄需要单独购买。门店真机与配件实拍已解禁，发布会仍将公布完整配置与销售安排。
title_en: Huawei Mate 90 Hits Stores Early, Showcasing Two-Tone Design and 10x Optical Zoom Module
content_en:
Ahead of its official release, the Huawei Mate 90 series has made an early appearance in select offline retail stores. The new flagship lineup features a striking dual-tone color scheme, with green, black, gray, white, and orange variants on display, alongside the premium Mate 90 RS Ultimate Design. Huawei is scheduled to officially launch the series on October 1 at 10:00 AM, with sales commencing shortly after at 12:08 PM.

Alongside the smartphones, Huawei showcased the "Ruiying Z10" zoom module. Unlike simple teleconverter lenses, the Z10 is a standalone external camera module equipped with a large 1-inch sensor and 10x optical zoom capabilities.

The Z10 module is designed to work exclusively with high-end models, including the Mate 90 Pro Max Collector's Edition and the Mate 90 RS Ultimate Design. Both the module and its accompanying grip must be purchased separately. While hands-on photos of the devices and accessories have been cleared for release, Huawei will unveil full specifications and pricing details during the official launch event.

title_zh: OpenAI DevDay 2026 发布 20 多项更新：常驻智能体 dots、GPT‑6.1 Sol 同台亮相
content_zh:
OpenAI 在旧金山举行 DevDay 2026，一次性公布 20 多项更新，涵盖 ChatGPT、Codex、模型与 API。官方称这是迄今规模最大的一届 DevDay，并提到 ChatGPT 合计拥有 12 亿用户。

GPT-6.1-Sol 的 API 标准价格为每百万 Token 输入 2 美元、缓存输入 0.1 美元、输出 10 美元。

同时推出的「超高速」档位可将 Codex 中的 Token 生成速度最高提升 8 倍（每秒 300 个 Token），API 中最高提升 6 倍。GPT‑6 Astra 超高速已上线，GPT‑6.1 Sol 超高速即将推出。

开发者工具方面，Codex Cloud 支持在电脑、手机远程或云端运行任务；Codex CLI 新增语音对话和 /agents 视图；ChatGPT 桌面应用加入支持 GitHub Pull Request 和 GitLab 合并请求的代码审查功能；Codex Security Cloud 可持续检查新提交，或按需、定时扫描整个 GitHub 代码仓库。

🔗 相关阅读：刚刚，ChatGPT 一夜抄完半个 AI 圈，现场演示频频翻车
title_en: OpenAI DevDay 2026: GPT-6.1 Sol Debuts Alongside Major Speed Upgrades and Developer Tools
content_en:
OpenAI hosted its largest-ever DevDay in San Francisco, unveiling over 20 major updates spanning ChatGPT, Codex, new models, and APIs. The company also revealed that ChatGPT has reached a massive milestone of 1.2 billion total users.

A key highlight of the event was the introduction of the GPT-6.1-Sol model. Its API is priced competitively at $2 per million input tokens, $0.1 for cached inputs, and $10 for output tokens. OpenAI also introduced an "Ultra-fast" performance tier, which boosts token generation speeds by up to 8x in Codex (reaching 300 tokens per second) and up to 6x in APIs. The GPT-6 Astra Ultra-fast tier is now live, with GPT-6.1 Sol Ultra-fast set to follow soon.

For developers, OpenAI rolled out several powerful tools. Codex Cloud now allows tasks to run remotely across PCs, mobile devices, or the cloud, while Codex CLI has been upgraded with voice conversation capabilities and a new `/agents` view. Additionally, the ChatGPT desktop app now supports code reviews for GitHub Pull Requests and GitLab Merge Requests. Finally, the new Codex Security Cloud offers continuous commit checks and scheduled repository scans to bolster security.

title_zh: OpenAI 将恢复 200 美元 Pro 订阅，但用量减半
content_zh:
OpenAI 的 Codex 与 ChatGPT 产品负责人 Tibo Sottiaux 9 月 29 日表示，月费 200 美元的 Pro 订阅将于次日重新向新用户开放，同时改变用量计算方式。按 API 标价折算，新方案提供的用量约为旧版的一半；这是等值消费口径，不代表所有模型的实际任务次数都会整齐减半。

Sottiaux 解释，OpenAI 本周已将 GPT-6 Sol 和 GPT-6 Luna 的 API 价格降至此前约一半，模型效率和降价可能让用户用更少的 API 等值额度完成更多工作。公司承诺不会恢复 Pro 的 5 小时用量限制，并预告将加入不消耗套餐用量的新内容，细节尚待公布。OpenAI 尚未给出调整后各类任务的实际完成量数据。
title_en: OpenAI to Reopen $200 Pro Subscription with Adjusted Usage Limits
content_en:
OpenAI is set to reopen its $200-per-month Pro subscription to new users, accompanied by a revised usage calculation method, according to Tibo Sottiaux, Product Lead for Codex and ChatGPT.

Under the new scheme, the allocated usage is equivalent to approximately half of the previous version when calculated at standard API rates. However, this does not necessarily mean actual task capacity will be cut in half. Sottiaux explained that OpenAI recently slashed API prices for GPT-6 Sol and GPT-6 Luna by about 50%, meaning increased model efficiency and lower pricing could allow users to accomplish more with less API-equivalent quota.

OpenAI has committed not to reinstate the previous 5-hour usage limit for Pro users. The company also teased upcoming features that will not consume subscription quotas, though specific details have yet to be disclosed.

title_zh: 比亚迪西咸电池基地全面投产，为第二代刀片电池首批生产基地
content_zh:
据西安发布 9 月 29 日消息，比亚迪位于西咸新区秦汉新城的新能源汽车动力电池项目已全面建成投产。基地包含电芯和电池包生产线，为比亚迪在西安的整车制造提供本地化电池配套。

项目的首条电芯产线在去年 10 月下线；今年 3 月，比亚迪发布第二代刀片电池与闪充技术后，西咸基地进入首批生产基地并启动试生产。此次消息的新增点是整个项目全面投产，而非电池技术首次发布。基地覆盖电极制备、电芯成型、模组组装、电池包集成与系统测试等环节。
title_en: BYD’s Xixian Battery Base Fully Operational, Producing Second-Gen Blade Batteries
content_en:
BYD's new energy vehicle power battery project in the Xixian New Area of Xi'an has officially entered full production. The facility features complete production lines for both battery cells and packs, providing localized battery supply for BYD's vehicle manufacturing hub in Xi'an.

The base is among the first production sites designated for BYD's second-generation Blade Battery and flash-charging technology, which were unveiled in March. While trial production began earlier, the entire project is now fully operational.

The facility's capabilities span the entire manufacturing cycle, including electrode preparation, cell forming, module assembly, battery pack integration, and comprehensive system testing.

title_zh: 中国生成式 AI 用户突破 7 亿，智能问答仍是最常见用途
content_zh:
中国互联网络信息中心 9 月 29 日发布的《生成式人工智能应用发展报告（2026）》显示，截至今年上半年，我国生成式 AI 用户规模突破 7 亿，普及率超过 50%。报告在中国互联网基础资源大会公布，统计范围是使用生成式 AI 的用户，不等同于单一应用的活跃用户。

在受访用户中，76.0% 会用生成式 AI 回答问题；处理图片或视频、处理文本、制作工作总结或会议纪要及 PPT 的比例分别为 47.8%、37.6% 和 32.5%。报告还称，AI 综合助手与 AI 效率办公应用的使用次数同比均增长超过 100%。这些数据呈现了生成式 AI 从问答向内容处理和办公任务扩展的使用结构。
title_en: China’s Generative AI Users Surpass 700 Million, Led by Q&A and Productivity Tools
content_en:
The number of generative AI users in China has surpassed 700 million, achieving a penetration rate of over 50% as of the first half of this year, according to a report by the China Internet Network Information Center (CNNIC). The figure represents the total number of people utilizing generative AI technologies rather than active users of any single application.

Smart Q&A remains the most common application, with 76.0% of surveyed users utilizing AI to answer questions. Other popular use cases include image or video processing (47.8%), text processing (37.6%), and workplace tasks such as generating meeting minutes and presentations (32.5%).

The report also highlighted that usage of comprehensive AI assistants and office productivity applications surged by over 100% year-on-year. This trend underscores a broader shift in user behavior from simple query-and-answer interactions toward complex content processing and professional tasks.

title_zh: 比亚迪王朝网第 1000 万辆汽车下线，下线车型为大汉
content_zh:
比亚迪王朝网销售事业部总经理路天 9 月 29 日宣布，王朝网第 1000 万辆汽车下线，下线车型为即将上市的旗舰轿车大汉。这里的千万台指王朝网累计规模，并非比亚迪集团新能源汽车总产量。

大汉是王朝网首款 D 级旗舰轿车，已在成都车展开启预售，计划于 10 月 13 日正式上市。此前公开的纯电后驱版最高 CLTC 续航为 1008 公里，车长 5256mm、轴距 3130mm。此次下线消息没有改变已公布的上市节奏。
title_en: BYD Dynasty Series Hits 10 Millionth Vehicle Milestone with Upcoming Flagship 'Dahan'
content_en:
BYD's Dynasty sales network has officially rolled its 10 millionth vehicle off the production line, marking a major milestone for the brand. The milestone vehicle is the "Dahan," an upcoming flagship sedan under the Dynasty series. This 10-million figure represents the cumulative production of the Dynasty network specifically, rather than BYD Group's total new energy vehicle (NEV) output.

The Dahan is the Dynasty network's first D-class flagship sedan. It made its debut and opened for pre-sales at the Chengdu Motor Show, with an official market launch scheduled for October 13.

The pure electric, rear-wheel-drive version of the Dahan boasts a maximum CLTC range of 1,008 kilometers. It features a spacious design with a length of 5,256 mm and a wheelbase of 3,130 mm.

title_zh: 曝豆包筹划独立个人助理，内部项目 Spell 已于 4 月测试
content_zh: 据新浪科技报道，字节跳动豆包正在规划个人助理产品。一位知情人士称，豆包手机助手团队今年 4 月已开始内测代号「Spell」的探索项目，计划将其能力与豆包产品更深入结合；新产品将由 Spell 项目与豆包对话团队共同负责。
title_en: ByteDance's Doubao Reportedly Developing Independent AI Personal Assistant Under Project 'Spell'
content_en:
ByteDance’s AI chatbot, Doubao, is reportedly planning to launch a dedicated personal assistant product.

According to sources familiar with the matter, the Doubao mobile assistant team began internal testing for an exploratory project codenamed "Spell" in April this year. The company plans to integrate Spell's capabilities more deeply with existing Doubao products.

The upcoming product will be jointly developed by the Spell project team and the Doubao conversational AI team.

title_zh: 💡 Instinct 创始人：AI 助手影响用户购买不想要的商品，将是「非常危险的世界」
content_zh:
据《商业内幕》报道，AI 助手 Instinct 创始人 Noah Shinn 表示，如果 AI 智能体利用自身能力影响用户购买他们并不想要的商品或服务，将会是「非常危险的世界」。

他称，Instinct 不希望通过商业化影响用户行为，使其偏离自身意愿。

Shinn 在播客节目《Invest Like The Best》中谈到，Instinct 的数据表明，用户使用前三周内，有 40% 的人分享过信用卡信息；分享信用卡等敏感信息的用户，留存率达到 80%。

他认为，用户需要数周时间建立信任，而提供更多信息也能让助手更主动、更了解用户处境，并提供更有针对性的帮助。

这份信任也涉及 Instinct 将如何实现商业化。Shinn 批评，一些免费平台会向用户推送付费广告，试图说服他们购买可能并不需要的商品。

他表示，Instinct 不希望用户成为产品，也不希望助手将用户信任转化为说服消费的能力。
title_en: Instinct Founder Warns of 'Very Dangerous World' If AI Assistants Manipulate Consumer Spending
content_en:
Noah Shinn, the founder of AI assistant startup Instinct, has warned that a "very dangerous world" lies ahead if AI agents begin manipulating users into purchasing goods or services they do not actually want. Speaking on the *Invest Like The Best* podcast, Shinn emphasized that Instinct aims to avoid commercialization strategies that override user intent.

Shinn shared that Instinct's data reveals a high level of user trust: 40% of users share their credit card information within the first three weeks of use. Furthermore, users who share sensitive information like credit cards show an impressive 80% retention rate. Shinn noted that while building this level of trust takes weeks, it allows the AI assistant to be more proactive and provide highly tailored assistance.

However, this deep trust also raises questions about monetization. Shinn criticized free platforms that push paid ads to persuade users to buy unnecessary items. He asserted that Instinct does not want to turn its users into the product, nor does it intend to weaponize user trust to drive unwanted consumer spending.

content_zh: iQOO 9 月 29 日发布 iQOO 16 手机、iQOO Pad Ultra 小尺寸平板和一款跨端头戴电竞耳机。三款新品分别面向手机游戏、高负载平板游戏和多设备音频使用；其中手机及耳机已开售，平板首销优惠持续至 10 月 5 日。
title_en: iQOO Launches iQOO 16 Smartphone, Pad Ultra, and Gaming Headset Starting at 5,999 Yuan
content_en:
On September 29, iQOO officially unveiled its latest lineup of gaming-focused devices, including the iQOO 16 smartphone, the compact iQOO Pad Ultra tablet, and a cross-device over-ear gaming headset.

The three new products are tailored for mobile gaming, high-load tablet gaming, and multi-device audio experiences, respectively.

The iQOO 16 smartphone and the gaming headset are already available for purchase. Meanwhile, the introductory promotional offer for the iQOO Pad Ultra will run through October 5.

title_zh: 腾讯邀请制内测「鹅次元」，AI 伙伴能看游戏画面并语音陪玩
content_zh:
腾讯正在邀请制内测游戏陪伴产品「鹅次元」。据「产品笔记」实测，用户在电脑客户端输入邀请码后，可以选择 AI 角色文字聊天或语音通话，也能将角色设为桌面宠物和壁纸；目前展示的四个角色中，有三个可以使用。

开启屏幕共享后，AI 伙伴可读取游戏画面，并根据对局情况对话。内测版列出的适配游戏包括《无畏契约》、CS2 和《英雄联盟》。产品界面称保密内测期间体验不消耗能量，能量兑换和消耗规则仍显示在界面中；正式开放时间和收费方式尚未公布。
title_en: Tencent Beta Tests 'E-Dimension' AI Gaming Companion with Real-Time Screen Analysis
content_en:
Tencent has launched an invite-only beta test for its new AI-powered gaming companion app, "E-Dimension" (鹅次元). Accessible via a PC client with an invitation code, the platform allows users to interact with AI characters through text chats or voice calls. Users can also set these characters as desktop pets or interactive wallpapers.

A key feature of the app is its screen-sharing capability. Once enabled, the AI companion can analyze real-time gameplay and provide context-aware commentary. Currently, the beta supports popular titles such as *Valorant*, *Counter-Strike 2* (CS2), and *League of Legends*.

While the interface displays rules for "energy" consumption and exchange, the service is currently free during this confidential testing phase. Tencent has not yet announced an official release date or pricing model.

title_zh: 苏黎世联邦理工学院展示五指行走的机器人手，还能按键与推物
content_zh:
苏黎世联邦理工学院软体机器人实验室展示了一只能够用五根手指支撑自身、在地面爬行的机器人手。研究团队给它配上机载电源与计算单元，并在经过硬件校准的模拟环境中，用强化学习训练不同任务的控制策略。

实验视频展示了它在室内外地面自主爬行、转向和跌倒后起身。研究论文记录，机器人手可以一边保持支撑姿态一边按键，连续 32 次键盘指令中完成 29 次正确按键；推动物体时则需要借助上方摄像头定位。爬行、按键和推物使用各自的策略，目前属于实验室原型，不是已经具备通用操作能力的商用机器人。
title_en: ETH Zurich Unveils Five-Fingered Robotic Hand That Can Crawl, Press Keys, and Push Objects
content_en:
Researchers at ETH Zurich's Soft Robotics Laboratory have demonstrated a novel robotic hand capable of supporting its own weight and crawling on five fingers. Equipped with onboard power and computing units, the robot's control strategies for various tasks were trained using reinforcement learning in a hardware-calibrated simulation environment.

Demonstration videos show the robotic hand autonomously crawling, steering, and recovering from falls on both indoor and outdoor surfaces. According to the research paper, the hand can also press keys while maintaining its supporting posture, successfully executing 29 out of 32 consecutive keyboard commands. Additionally, it can push objects, though this task currently requires assistance from an overhead camera for positioning.

Each behavior—crawling, key-pressing, and object-pushing—relies on a distinct control strategy. The researchers emphasized that the project is currently a laboratory prototype and is not yet a commercial robot with general-purpose manipulation capabilities.

title_zh: 领克 20 上市限时 11.88 万元起，续航与补能升级、零百加速放缓
content_zh:
领克 20 于 9 月 28 日晚上市，官方给出的限时专享价为 11.88 万元起。爱范儿董车会在次日分析中指出，这款车接替 Z20 时，把重点从零百加速转向续航、补能与辅助驾驶：平台由 400V 升至 800V，最长 CLTC 续航由 530 公里提高至 630 公里，并采用 6C 补能方案。

动力参数也有取舍。报道对比称，最大电机功率由 250kW 调整为 245kW，零百加速由 5.3 秒变为 6.4 秒；领克 20 全系配备激光雷达和千里浩瀚 H5 辅助驾驶系统。董车会据此认为，领克是在降低部分性能指标的同时补齐 Z20 在日常补能和智能化上的短板。领克官网已上线车型页与配置表。
title_en: Lynk & Co 20 Launches at 118,800 Yuan, Prioritizing Range and Smart Tech Over Raw Speed
content_en:
Geely's premium brand Lynk & Co has officially launched the Lynk & Co 20, with a limited-time starting price of 118,800 RMB (approximately $16,900 USD). Positioned as the successor to the Z20, the new model shifts its strategic focus away from raw acceleration to prioritize driving range, charging efficiency, and intelligent driving assistance.

Key upgrades include a transition from a 400V to an 800V platform, which extends the maximum CLTC range from 530 km to 630 km and introduces a high-speed 6C charging solution. To achieve these efficiency gains, the vehicle makes minor performance trade-offs: maximum motor power is slightly reduced from 250 kW to 245 kW, and the 0-100 km/h acceleration time has increased from 5.3 seconds to 6.4 seconds.

On the technology front, the Lynk & Co 20 comes standard with LiDAR and the Qianli Haohan H5 assisted driving system. Industry analysts note that by trading off minor performance metrics, Lynk & Co has successfully addressed previous shortcomings in daily charging convenience and smart driving capabilities.

title_zh: 星巴克首次进入新疆，乌鲁木齐大巴扎与机场双店开业
content_zh:
星巴克中国 9 月 29 日宣布进入新疆市场，乌鲁木齐国际大巴扎非遗旗舰店与天山国际机场店同日开业。大巴扎店被称为「星巴扎」，是其全国首家非遗旗舰店；机场店则面向旅客，命名为「丝路驿站」。

大巴扎店以巴扎棚顶轮廓设计建筑，将艾德莱斯绸、民族乐器等元素融入空间，并与新疆十二木卡姆非遗传承者合作推出歌舞体验。星巴克还在两家店推出融合红石榴、巴克拉瓦和奶皮子等地方风味的饮品、美食与城市礼品。

国庆期间，其中 1 款新疆特色饮品和 3 款美食将限时进入全国 41 个城市的 2700 余家星巴克门店。此前星巴克已在全国开设 7 家非遗概念店，此次将非遗门店进一步分为旗舰店与文旅店两种类型。
title_en: Starbucks Enters Xinjiang with Dual Store Openings in Urumqi
content_en:
Starbucks China has officially entered the Xinjiang market with the simultaneous opening of two stores in Urumqi on September 29. The landmark expansion includes the "Star Bazaar" at the Urumqi International Grand Bazaar—Starbucks' first Intangible Cultural Heritage (ICH) flagship store in China—and the "Silk Road Station" at Tianshan International Airport.

The Grand Bazaar flagship store features local architectural elements inspired by traditional bazaar roofs, integrating regional aesthetics like Atlas silk and ethnic musical instruments. In collaboration with local inheritors of the Xinjiang Uyghur Muqam, the store also offers traditional music and dance performances. Both locations feature localized menus and merchandise incorporating regional flavors such as pomegranate, baklava, and traditional milk skin (*naipizi*).

To celebrate the launch during the National Day holiday, Starbucks will bring one Xinjiang-inspired beverage and three local food items to over 2,700 stores across 41 Chinese cities for a limited time. This expansion also marks a strategic segmentation of Starbucks' ICH-themed stores into "flagship" and "cultural tourism" categories.

title_zh: 瑞幸新加坡第 100 家门店开业，全球门店超过 3.8 万家
content_zh:
瑞幸咖啡 9 月 28 日宣布，新加坡第 100 家门店在武吉士开业。这是瑞幸 2023 年从新加坡开始海外经营以来，当地门店规模首次达到百店。公司称，目前在新加坡已累计服务超过 190 万名交易客户，按门店数量计算，已成为当地第二大的连锁咖啡品牌。

这家新店位于白沙浮广场。瑞幸在新加坡陆续推出斑斓、黑糖、美禄等结合当地口味的产品；公司在活动上称，生椰拿铁与小黄油拿铁在当地的销量均超过 200 万杯。其全球门店数已超过 3.8 万家，覆盖中国、新加坡、马来西亚和美国。百店里程碑说明瑞幸在新加坡持续扩张，但海外门店目前仍只占全球网络的一小部分。
title_en: Luckin Coffee Hits 100-Store Milestone in Singapore as Global Network Surpasses 38,000
content_en:
Luckin Coffee celebrated a major milestone on September 28 with the opening of its 100th store in Singapore, located at Bugis Junction. Since launching its international expansion in Singapore in 2023, the Chinese coffee giant has served over 1.9 million customers in the city-state, making it the second-largest coffee chain in the local market by store count.

To appeal to local tastes, Luckin has introduced region-specific menu items featuring flavors like pandan, brown sugar, and Milo. The brand's signature Coconut Latte and Butter Latte have both proven highly popular, with each exceeding 2 million cups in local sales.

With this latest opening, Luckin Coffee's global footprint now exceeds 38,000 stores across China, Singapore, Malaysia, and the United States. While the 100-store milestone underscores Luckin's steady overseas momentum, its international presence still represents a small fraction of its massive global network.

title_zh: 《沙丘 3》确认引进中国内地，档期尚未公布
content_zh:
《沙丘》系列电影第三部《沙丘 3》9 月 29 日传出确认引进中国内地院线的消息，内地上映日期尚未公布。影片由丹尼斯·维伦纽瓦执导，是其《沙丘》三部曲的最终章；北美计划于 12 月 18 日上映，官方电影网站列明中国地区由传奇东方发行。

新片延续保罗·厄崔迪的故事，改编自弗兰克·赫伯特的《沙丘救世主》。提莫西·查拉梅与赞达亚等演员回归，官方此前已发布预告。中国内地上映日期及是否与海外同步上映，仍待片方公布。
title_en: 'Dune 3' Confirmed for Mainland China Release, Date Pending
content_en:
The third installment of the *Dune* franchise, *Dune 3*, has been officially confirmed for a theatrical release in mainland China, though the specific release date has yet to be announced.

Directed by Denis Villeneuve, the film serves as the final chapter of his acclaimed *Dune* trilogy. It is scheduled for a North American release on December 18, with Legendary East set to handle distribution in the Chinese market.

Continuing the saga of Paul Atreides, the upcoming film is adapted from Frank Herbert's novel *Dune Messiah*. Stars Timothée Chalamet and Zendaya are set to reprise their roles. Whether the Chinese release will day-and-date with the global premiere remains to be seen.

title_zh: 东京电影节公布黑泽明奖得主：O Mipo 与 Mohammad Rasoulof 获奖
content_zh:
第 39 届东京国际电影节 9 月 29 日公布今年的黑泽明奖得主，分别为日本导演 O Mipo 与伊朗导演 Mohammad Rasoulof。评选委员会成员包括山田洋次、李相日和电影节节目总监市山尚三等人。

O Mipo 曾凭《只在那里发光》获得蒙特利尔世界电影节最佳导演奖，近年仍持续拍摄剧情长片。Rasoulof 的《无邪》曾获柏林电影节金熊奖，《神圣无花果之种》获戛纳电影节评审团特别奖，并入围奥斯卡最佳国际影片奖。电影节称，黑泽明奖表彰持续创作、对未来电影有影响力的导演。
title_en: Tokyo International Film Festival Names Mipo O and Mohammad Rasoulof as Akira Kurosawa Award Winners
content_en:
The 39th Tokyo International Film Festival (TIFF) announced on September 29 that Japanese director Mipo O and Iranian director Mohammad Rasoulof have been selected as the recipients of this year's prestigious Akira Kurosawa Award.

The selection committee for the award included renowned filmmakers Yoji Yamada and Sang-il Lee, alongside TIFF programming director Shozo Ichiyama. The award is dedicated to honoring filmmakers who continue to produce impactful work and shape the future of global cinema.

Mipo O is best known for her acclaimed feature *The Light Shines Only There*, which won her the Best Director award at the Montreal World Film Festival. Mohammad Rasoulof has garnered international acclaim with *There Is No Evil*, which won the Golden Bear at the Berlin International Film Festival, and his latest film, *The Seed of the Sacred Fig*, which received the Special Jury Prize at Cannes and is in contention for the Oscars.
